notes: The operator identifies the karting facility at 2633 Upper James Street. Exact pinned public source nodes preserve the historical course; the adjacent northern track, its linking stem and the separate pit approach are excluded. This descriptive component name does not assert an official configuration name, and historical timed choice and direction remain draft. This complementary course retains the southern outer bend and the lower connecting alternative. Exact source coordinates are unchanged; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 16 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Physical image-edge pairs reused without moving coordinates on supported shared pavement from Historical southern course A, with independent measurements for the differing branches and closure. Pinned Ontario SWOOP2020 imagery matches the historical southern pavement before the rebuild. Unmeasured intervals and route limits through branch openings are interpolated estimates, not a continuous pavement survey. Historical configuration identity and direction remain draft. Curbs are illustrative and banking is unknown. This recipe retains 152 shared edge positions, 86 further edge positions measured for this route, and two repeated closure anchors.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed from complete pairs of sparse image-edge measurements. Each pair defines its own road section; the original trace is preserved and constrains station displacement and route order. Linear intervals, junction openings and curbs remain estimates, not surveyed racing limits. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. No automatic evidence scores are claimed.
